blocks.text: The SOC Workbench Dashboard is designed to provide high-level information about your organization's current risk of a data breach. The dashboard is divided into a series of tables and interactive charts and graphs. You can simply click chart data to see more detailed information. You can also use default views and custom filtering to better understand how alerts relate to actual incidents, as well as your organization’s placement within the MITRE ATT&CK framework during a specified period. Most importantly, the dashboard lets you focus on incidents instead of alerts, showing you the statuses of incidents across your organization, including which users and hosts have been affected.
The SOC Workbench Dashboard provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: See a high-level overview of your organization's current risk of a data breach.
View information about alerts vs. incidents across your organization.
Use interactive charts and graphs to understand how alerts from different sources are affecting your organization.

blocks.heading: About the SOC Workbench Dashboard Page

blocks.text: On the SOC Workbench Dashboard page (Agentic SOC > Dashboard), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Select from system-saved views, or views you previously saved.
Set the date range for the data on the dashboard.
Filter the alert and incident information on the page, and add new filters to control the information you see.
View alert and incident information, along with trends for the previous 30 days.
Compare the number of alerts vs. the number of incidents across your organization.
See the statuses of identified incidents.
View the mean time to respond for incidents across your organization.
See a list of the top 5 devices affected by incidents in your organization.
View a list of the top 5 high-risk incidents in your organization.
See the top 5 alerts generated by applications vs. the number of actual incidents.
View where Agentic SOC places the alerts in your organization on the list of MITRE ATT&CK tactics.
